Subject: Leaking Kitchen Faucet – Repair Request

Hi [Landlord's Name],

I hope you're doing well. I wanted to let you know that the kitchen faucet in my unit has developed a leak and has been dripping steadily for the past few days. I haven't attempted any repairs myself and wanted to flag it so a plumber can take a look before it leads to water damage or higher water bills.

Please let me know a convenient time for someone to come by, or if you'd like me to arrange access another way. Happy to answer any questions in the meantime.

Thank you,
[Your Name]
[Unit/Address]
[Phone Number]

Fill in the bracketed details before sending — want me to adjust the tone or add anything (e.g., how long it's been leaking, preferred contact method)?
